mentions.name: From-Scratch Recursive DNS Resolver
mentions.description: A recursive DNS resolver written from scratch as a learning project, implementing the DNS wire protocol based on the DNS RFCs, with no AI assistance.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm doing a learning project(strictly no AI): writing a recursive dns resolver from scratch. It's been fun reading the DNS RFCs, implementing the wire protocol, and writing code by hand.
mentions.author: imperfectfourth
